name: Moderator Simulator 2
detailed_description:
In Moderator Simulator 2, you'll take the role of a "GamerTALK" server owner as you punish rule-breakers, unlock new features, and become the greatest moderator of all time!

In Story Mode, play as a teenager who has just discovered the GamerTALK chatting platform for the first time.  As a transfer student to a brand new high school, you'll grow your server's popularity while facing the daily challenges of a broken education system... striking the right balance is essential to living your best life!

You'll play through several "days" of interacting with your human counterparts in school, completing quizzes, trying to win over your crush, and staying up too late to win fake internet points!  Your actions in real-time scenarios will have consequences on your ending, often even intertwining.  Will you be able to complete every ending?

If drudging through the mindless tedium of high school sounds too scary for you (don't worry— it is for me too!), then Freeplay is the mode for you!  Grow your GamerTALK server with no time restrictions, all upgrades unlockable from the start, and an endless amount of user interactions to discover!

With all the time in the world to develop your community, you'll constantly be faced with dilemmas facing your server that threaten the survival of your server in a social-heavy environment.  As the scenarios constantly increase in difficulty, making too many poor decisions will lead to your server's downfall... and there's zero take-backs!

Through multiplayer, Join in groups of up to four players as everyone manages the same, equivalently scaled GamerTALK server!  Every player will contribute to the server's rise and fall, placing group votes on major decisions and handling minor disputes individually.

With the frequency of dilemmas endlessly increasing, see how much progress your group can make before succumbing to everyone's collective failures!  Plus, to recognize your outstanding performance (yes, YOU specifically), you'll be given one of dozens of potential titles at the end of your run!  Good luck collecting all of those for the achievement...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 v21H1 (build 19043)
  • Processor: Ryzen 5 2600, or Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 v24H2 (build 26100)
  • Processor: Ryzen 7 3700X, or Intel Core i7-9700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 or Vulkan capable GPUs

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Big Sur 11
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
